title: Are Organic Foods More Nutritious?
summary: Finds organic produce no richer in vitamins and minerals but higher in polyphenols, and not clearly better value per dollar.

assertions.quote: they didn't find robust evidence to support that perception
organic fruits and vegetables had between 19 and 69% more of a variety of these antioxidant compounds
organic strawberries may taste sweeter and better
clinical studies on the impact of eating organic on human disease simply haven't been done
organic produce may be 40% more expensive
from a purely nutrients-per-dollar standpoint, it's not clear that organic foods are any better
Plants given high dose synthetic nitrogen fertilizers may divert more resources to growth rather than defense.

verdicts.note: Higher nitrogen availability is linked to lower phenolic content in some crops, but the effect varies and is not the only cause.

Authors cite increasing evidence that high mineral N inputs lower phenolic defence compounds (wheat, apple, tomato), with plants shifting carbon to growth under high N, but say more research is needed to separate fertiliser from pest effects.
Under high nitrogen availability many plant tissues contain less phenolic compounds, though there are examples of the opposite.
